derivation.boxSecret: HKDF(seed, info="fc/v1/box") is the RFC 7748 X25519 secret key (clamped on use)
derivation.fingerprint: SHA-256("fc/v1/fingerprint\n" || lp(signPub) || lp(boxPub)), bytes 0..30 as 6 big-endian 40-bit numbers mod 100000
